Payout of 7 July is short ₹5,652.88.
The bank credited ₹2,98,268.49 against an expected ₹3,03,921.37. 29 orders sit in this payout. 3 different combinations of ledger entries add up to this difference and nothing in the records tells them apart, so no single explanation can be given.
Suggested action: ask the gateway which entries it deducted from this payout, since the amounts alone cannot separate them.
